description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Recent sales' table tab in the Properties
section.

Properties sold in the suburb, with beds/baths/land size, sale price and
date, and coordinates, newest sale first.

**Default:** the last 3 years, one row per property (its most recent sale).

**Full history:** pass `from` and/or `to` (YYYY-MM-DD) for every sale in that
range — one row per sale, so a property sold twice appears twice. History
depth varies by state: NSW from 2001, Victoria, Queensland, WA and SA from
about 2010, Tasmania from about 2014, ACT and NT from 2019.

Paginated with `limit`/`offset`: `total` reports how many sales match
(counted before paging) and `next_offset` is the offset of the next page
(null on the last one). Order is stable — newest first, ties broken by
property — so paging never repeats or skips a sale. Each page is one call,
at a flat price regardless of page size.

from.description: Earliest sale date to include (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Passing `from` or `to` returns EVERY sale in the range, one row per sale, instead of the default last-3-years feed.

offset.description: Row offset — page through the feed with `limit`. `next_offset` in the response is the value for the next page.

to.description: Latest sale date to include (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Default: today.
